rows.reason: VCO output band: static band codes with a per-corner measured envelope; corner-bounded, no per-die statistical population is claimed
reference input contract: electrical limits are conditions on the driving system, not statistical populations of this block
divider multiplication ratio: static configuration with a corner-bounded retiming margin; no per-die statistical population is claimed
integrated RMS jitter is deliberately unspecified (DR-002 Decision 5); no row exists to be statistical
period jitter: its random half is a deterministic per-corner bound (DR-032), not a sampled population; it is carried as a declared gap on the analog partition's item-6 row set, not here
phase noise is deliberately unspecified (DR-002 Decision 5); no row exists to be statistical
reference spur: a deterministic dBc bound; its derivation folds the charge-pump budget's dispersion terms, which are evidenced by the analog partition's item-6 citations
loop bandwidth: corner-bounded small-signal measurement over the contracted reference range
phase margin: corner-bounded small-signal measurement over the contracted reference range
lock time: corner-bounded small-signal settling measurement
power: derived total over all domains, corner-bounded; no per-die statistical population is claimed
standby current: no power-down mode exists in v1, so no state and no population exists to measure
supply sensitivity: pushing figure and Vctrl-window consumption are corner-bounded measurements
output duty cycle: corner-bounded over 90 measured points
output levels and drive: corner-bounded over 90 measured points
area: a drawn quantity, not a PVT-varying population
lock detector: assert window, hysteresis and chatter are corner-bounded at every PVT point (205-point in-situ re-characterization); no per-die statistical population is claimed
Kvco: corner-bounded at every legal operating point under the band-selection rule
supply range: the independent variable every other row's corner binding sweeps, not a statistical claim
